title: NRP Advanced Provider Course
seo_title: NRP Advanced Provider Course in Springfield, MO
description: This is a course on advanced newborn resuscitation skills, where participants work toward AAP/AHA NRP certification. It takes place Thursday, December 17, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM at Cox North Education Center, K400, Classroom #1, at 1423 N Jefferson Ave in Springfield, MO. Enter on the Robberson St. side at the door labeled Northwest Entrance.
